title: Salon kit (template) — chairs full, not inboxes full
description: Enquiry to slot to rebooking. WhatsApp-first for salons and spas.

hero.headline: From empty slot to booking and rebooking.
hero.copy: Night DMs for bridal and hair colour wait until morning. This kit replies, takes a slot request, reminds, and asks for a review after a good visit.

messages.text: Hi, do you have a balayage slot this Saturday?
Saturday afternoon has two colour slots. Hair length — shoulder or longer?
Request saved. The colourist will confirm time and patch-test rules.

problem.title: Chairs sit empty while DMs sit unanswered.
copy: The stylist is with a client. Instagram does not wait.

fixes.title: Reminders
fixes.copy: Fewer no-shows on bridal and colour.

fixes.title: Review ask
fixes.copy: After a completed visit, not a random blast.

cards.title: Slot request
cards.copy: Service menu you approved. No mystery prices for custom colour until staff say so.

workflow.title: One thread from the bio link.
workflow.copy: Front desk is not typing the same three questions.

steps.title: DM or WhatsApp
steps.copy: From Instagram, Maps, or walk-in QR.

niches.title: Salons, spas, barbers, nail
niches.copy: Change the menu JSON. Keep chemical-service confirmation.

control.title: The owner owns the menu.
control.copy: Prices and packages stay in approved lists.

faq.a: It requests. Staff confirm patch tests and timing.
Yes — the kit assumes IG and WhatsApp meet in one record.

form.title: Build a salon demo from this kit.
form.copy: Tell us chairs, services, and the leak.

whatsapp.demoText: Hi Webwise, I want a salon kit demo.

resultCard.leakLabel: Missed colour or bridal chats. Range only.
resultCard.story: An unanswered Saturday DM is an empty chair, not a branding problem.

leakQuiz.q: How fast do you reply after hours?

rules.systemPrompt: Salon front desk. Capture service, day, stylist. Staff confirm chemical services. No skin diagnosis.

approved.response: Ask service and preferred time. Save the request for staff confirmation.

rules.fallback: The front desk will confirm this service.
